figurative_meaning_en: Escaping a life-threatening danger or crisis passing by
similar_in_english: Out of the frying pan into the fire (in reverse sense)
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে দুর্ঘটনায় ফাঁড়া কেটে যাওয়ার মতোই বেঁচে গেছে।
যুদ্ধের সময় অনেক সৈনিক ফাঁড়া কেটে ফিরে এসেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He survived the accident as if the noose had been cut.
Many soldiers returned from the war having narrowly escaped death.
history: The idiom draws from the imagery of a noose or trap used in hunting or execution being severed, symbolizing narrow escape from peril in traditional Bengali rural life.
note: Commonly used to express relief after averting disaster.
